# SelectionSlider { #anylumino.SelectionSlider }

```python
SelectionSlider(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
    orientation='horizontal',
    readout=True,
)
```

Slider selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                              | Default    |
|-------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| index | optional | Selected option index. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |
| orientation | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``. | `'horizontal'` |
| readout | optional | Slider readout visibility or validity readout text. | `True` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [behavior](#anylumino.SelectionSlider.behavior) | Slider dragging behavior. |
| [continuous_update](#anylumino.SelectionSlider.continuous_update) | Update the value of the widget as the user is holding the slider. |
| [orientation](#anylumino.SelectionSlider.orientation) | Vertical or horizontal. |
| [readout](#anylumino.SelectionSlider.readout) | Display the current selected label next to the slider |
| [style](#anylumino.SelectionSlider.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
